answer_4.quote: We also conduct human experimental analysis via a publicly available human-annotation dataset... This dataset contains 100 dialogue-summary pairs with human annotations in terms of quality, evaluated from seven dimensions...
answer_4.guideline: Human annotations evaluated summaries based on seven error types: Extrinsic Information, Mis-Referencing, Stating Opinion As Fact, Reasoning Error, Tense/Modality Error, Contradiction, Nuanced Meaning Shift.
